title: Travel Journal: Four Design Worlds
description: Each preview interprets the same travel-memory product through a different visual metaphor. Pick a direction before integrating any code.

variants.name: Field Notes
variants.concept: A tactile journal with paper, stamps, marginalia, and handwritten details.
variants.tradeoff: Warm and personal, but needs discipline to avoid visual clutter.

variants.name: Cinematic
variants.concept: A personal film archive with dramatic frames and restrained typography.
variants.tradeoff: High emotional impact; requires strong visual memories.

variants.name: Atlas
variants.concept: A relationship told through routes, waypoints, and cartographic details.
variants.tradeoff: Great for location-rich memories; less suited to stories without places.

variants.name: Postcard Party
variants.concept: Bold souvenir graphics, stickers, exaggerated hierarchy, playful physicality.
variants.tradeoff: Memorable and energetic, but can compete with the content.
